macros.name: gothamFootlineDepth
macros.doc: \gothamFootlineHeight and \gothamFootlineDepth are controlling the height and depth of the footline baseline.

macros.name: gothamFootlineHeight
macros.doc: \gothamFootlineHeight and \gothamFootlineDepth are controlling the height and depth of the footline baseline.

macros.name: gothamFootlineHRightOffset
macros.doc: \gothamFootlineHRightOffset is controlling the horizontal space between the right border of the page and the side of the footline.

macros.name: gothamFootlineRuleHeight
macros.doc: \gothamFootlineRuleHeight controls the height and \gothamFootlineRuleLength the length of the rule used to delimit the footer.

macros.name: gothamFootlineRuleLeftPadding
macros.doc: \gothamFootlineRuleLeftPadding is controlling the horizontal space between the left border of the page and the left side of the rule.

macros.name: gothamFootlineRuleLength
macros.doc: \gothamFootlineRuleHeight controls the height and \gothamFootlineRuleLength the length of the rule used to delimit the footer.

macros.name: gothamFrameSubtitleSep
macros.doc: \gothamFrameSubtitleSep Command defining the separator used between the frametitle and the subtitle.

macros.name: gothamFrametitleLeftpading
macros.doc: Dimensions of lengths used in the frametitle: top, bottom, left and right padding.

macros.name: gothamFrametitleRightpading
macros.doc: Dimensions of lengths used in the frametitle: top, bottom, left and right padding.

macros.name: gothamHookFooter
macros.doc: The command to add elements (like a logo) in the footer without redefining it completely.

macros.name: gothamInstituteLogoCircle
macros.doc: Command to include the circular logo of your institute in the frametitle when using \ gothamset{progressbar position=circlehead}.

macros.name: gothamProgressCircBorderWidth
macros.doc: Lengths controlling the aspect of progress circle.

macros.name: gothamProgressCircHeight
macros.doc: \gothamProgressCircHeight is controlling the inner height of the circle (related to its diameter).

macros.name: gothamProgressHeadFootLineheight
macros.doc: \gothamProgressHeadFootLineheight is controlling the height of the progress bar in normal frames (or its width when it is put in side bars).

macros.name: gothamRightFooterPadding
macros.doc: Lengths used in footer template for positioning left right and bottom.
